## Can we do this with MLIR? {#circt-route}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="42%"}
The highlighted core dialects match the concepts we just used:

- **`hw`**: structure and hierarchy
- **`comb`**: combinational logic
- **`seq`**: state

**Upstream (top):** source/front-end, more abstract.<br>
**Downstream (bottom):** HDL/back-end, closer to implementation.

::: {.fragment}
CIRCT also contains other hardware dialects, transformations, analyses, and
tools.

[Next: use the tools.]{.marker}
